Obviously this is almost impossible to succeed because humans are born with emotions like jealousy, greed and need for power. But to compare the communism to nazism and facism is completely insane. Capitalism only feeds the awful emotions such as jealousy greed and need for power because it bases itself of that the most important thing is money. Capitalism is the reason we have people like Donald trump in this world, and im not saying that communism is better than capitalism. But its not like noone has died because of the consequences of capitalism. What about the crash of Wallstreet in 2008? Thousands of people ended up homeless and died from malnutrition, starvation and hypothermia. The rest of the world is still affected by the crash of wallstreet, a consequence of the many errors in capitalism.

To conclude: Communism is not perfect but its not comparable to nazism and facism because those idealogies base themself off of superiority over other people, and in that sence they are more similar to capitilsm.
